raw:
Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator prematurely assumed the Bing results were wheelchair-accessible bars (“We have identified several wheelchair-accessible bars in the area.”) and shifted to distance calculations without verifying accessibility or curating an actually nearby set. This led to 12 Steps Down—likely not wheelchair accessible (a basement bar)—being treated as a valid candidate and ultimately (after only one distance was computed) output as the answer.
